headline: Tech Firm Makes Attendance Mandatory for Employees to Join Zoom Calls from Inside Office Cubicles
body:
A prominent Bengaluru-based software consultancy has mandated that all staff must report to the office specifically to attend their company-wide Zoom meetings, arguing that the 'synergy of physical proximity' is essential for muting one another efficiently. The new policy, titled 'Project Together-Apart,' requires employees to travel for up to two hours in peak traffic just to sit in their designated pods and engage in breakout rooms with colleagues sitting three desks away.

'We noticed that when employees were at home, their Wi-Fi signals were too reliable, leading to a lack of authentic corporate anxiety,' said Rajesh Varma, the Chief Synergy Architect. 'By bringing everyone back, we can recreate the classic office experience of having someone’s keyboard clacking loudly in your ear while you try to present a slide deck, which is the cornerstone of professional excellence.'

To ensure total compliance, the office has installed noise-canceling headsets that are remotely controlled by HR to play a looped recording of ambient office chatter and printer jams. Employees are also encouraged to occasionally stand up and walk to the coffee machine mid-call to maintain the authentic experience of experiencing a spotty internet connection despite being on a high-speed corporate network.
caption: Back to basics! Because nothing says productivity like commuting 15km to talk to a screen. The future of work is finally here, and it looks suspiciously like the past. #OfficeLife #CorporateIndia #WFH #BengaluruDiaries (satire)
